question: The path that keeps the most time

scene.title: The path that keeps the most time
scene.subtitle: Height gains time, speed loses it. The arc a ball really follows is the best trade.
scene.takeaway: A falling ball is not pushed. It follows the path between two moments that keeps the most time.

beats.title: No gravity: stay put
beats.body: Without gravity, a thrown clock only loses time by moving. Staying put keeps the most time, just like the home twin.

beats.title: Turn gravity on
beats.body: Now clocks run faster higher up, so going up gains time. But getting there means moving fast, which loses time. A low throw gains little, and a high throw loses too much.

beats.title: The best trade
beats.body: The path that keeps the most time is exactly the arc a thrown ball follows. Change the gravity and the best arc changes with it.

scene.next: Next: which of these paths is the one nothing pushes? See “Who is really falling?”.
